newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangdong Power 96 net hits 558 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: Guangdong Power 96 net hits 558 mln yuan.

text.p: Guangdong Electric Power Development Co Ltd recorded net 1996 profit of 557.81 million yuan, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said in a notice after the market closed on Thursday.
Earnings per share were 0.676 yuan in 1996 and turnover reached 2.12 billion yuan, the exchange said.
It did not specify whether the results were compiled under Chinese or international accounting standards and gave no comparative figures.
The company posted net profits of 376.97 million yuan on international accounting standards in 1995, the company's 1995 results said.
Under Chinese standards, it had net profits of 371.03 million yuan in 1995, it said.
The firm proposed a two-for-10 bonus issue and a cash dividend of 0.2 yuan per share based on 1996 profits, the exchange said.
Trading in the company's A and B shares will be suspended on Friday morning to resume in the afternoon, it said.
